title: Felt Snow at Dawn
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: ambient, beatless-to-minimal (Selected Ambient Works feel). Register focus: chord/pad-led with sparse piano accents. Palette: warm pad bed + felt piano + minimal brushed LinnDrum perc. Tempo: 80 BPM. Arc shape: slow-burn build that never fully lands. Mood modifier: dreamy, isolated, hazy.
description: A warm low pad bed drifts under felt-piano chords that bloom and decay like breath on cold glass, slowly gathering a brushed, half-there pulse that never quite resolves into a beat. Hazy, isolated, and dreamlike, it keeps opening toward a landing it never reaches.
